result.summary: The page is largely well-composed: header, search bar, category chips, promo banner, carousels, and bottom navigation all render correctly. The horizontally clipped carousel item at the right edge and the card cut off at the bottom of the viewport are expected scroll behaviors and were not counted as defects. One notable visual anomaly remains: the notification/avatar button in the top-right corner appears as an empty gray circle with a tiny red dot, lacking any icon or image content.

issues.description: The circular button in the top-right corner (next to the delivery address) renders as a blank light-gray circle with only a small red notification dot; no bell, avatar, or icon glyph is visible inside it, making the control's purpose unclear and looking like a failed asset load.
issues.suggestion: Render the intended icon (e.g., notification bell or user avatar image) inside the circular button, keeping the red badge as an unread indicator; verify the icon asset or font loads correctly.

issues.description: The red notification badge on the empty gray circle is very small and has no accompanying visible icon or label, so sighted users cannot tell what the badge refers to; screen-reader users also get no textual cue from the visual alone.
issues.suggestion: Pair the badge with a recognizable icon and provide an accessibility label such as 'Notifications, 1 unread' on the button.
